title: Implement Vaporize technical evidence for the Microsoft Store pipeline
description: Add the Windows technical realization adapter needed by the canonical Microsoft Store release lane. Vaporize consumes an inspection-approved digest-bound handoff, materializes the policy-selected Windows store package, verifies identity and signing, runs certification and lifecycle journeys, and emits immutable evidence for Launch Review. It never approves a lane or publishes without a separate exact operation authorization.
expectedBehavior: Given one declared Windows release cell, Vaporize deterministically produces or locates the store package, records package and publisher identity, signs and verifies it, validates manifest/capabilities, exercises clean install/launch/update/uninstall/rollback, invokes the configured certification adapter, and emits a submission bundle or authorized Partner Center handoff with typed receipts. The existing Apple pipeline remains intact behind its own adapter.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter consumes project, candidate, inspection, policy, platform, architecture, configuration, pipeline, and authorization LinkRefs and binds their resolved digests.
Package format and bundle topology are selected by effective policy and recorded rather than assumed globally.
Package identity, publisher identity, certificate chain, timestamping policy, manifest capabilities, and signature verification are emitted as typed evidence.
Automated fixtures cover clean install, first launch, update, uninstall, rollback or recovery, and declared migration paths on supported Windows cells.
The certification adapter captures tool identity/version, policy profile, diagnostics, remediation references, and terminal result.
The output includes Partner Center-ready package, listing/assets manifest, privacy/rating declarations, locale coverage, and immutable content digests.
Submission, staged rollout, halt, withdrawal, and rollback execute only with exact short-lived operation authorization and emit attempt/receipt records.
Dry-run and offline modes can produce a complete handoff without external Partner Center mutation.
Apple and Microsoft adapters share portable technical interfaces while preserving their platform-specific evidence types.
Vaporize never synthesizes Foundry Inspect compliance, Launch Review approval, or store publication authority.
risks: Embedding store credentials or certificates in project configuration would leak authority and secrets.
Treating a successful local package build as certification or store acceptance would overstate readiness.
Coupling Microsoft implementation to Apple-specific stages would make both pipelines fragile.
